name: MBPHA TeleHealth Dashboard Design System
description: Extracted visual/structural design language from a healthcare admin dashboard UI, for use as AI context to replicate consistent screens. Content values (names, dates, records) are intentionally excluded — this profile describes STYLE and STRUCTURE only.

designStyle.category: Enterprise healthcare admin dashboard / SaaS console
visualPrinciples: High information density achieved through card-based modular grouping rather than dense tables alone
Strong left-hand persistent navigation (dark) contrasted against a light content canvas
Consistent card metaphor: every functional block (stats, lists, calendar, charts, forms) is a white rounded rectangle with a subtle border/shadow
Color is used functionally (status, category) far more than decoratively
Generous whitespace between cards but fairly compact whitespace within cards to maximize scannable data
Rounded corners throughout (soft-geometric, not sharp, not fully pill except badges/buttons)
Minimal iconography, line-style icons, used as small functional markers not decoration
Flat design with very subtle elevation (soft shadows), no skeuomorphism, no gradients except optional hero banner image

usageRules: Navy (#17375E) reserved for sidebar/nav chrome, major headings, and structural labels — never used as a large content background
Medical Blue reserved for primary actions, active nav states, links, and pending/info status chips
Emerald Green = approved/completed/success; Medical Blue = pending/active; Red = cancelled/blocked/expired; Gray = neutral/inactive
Status color always paired: light tint background + saturated text, never solid-fill unless it's a dot/icon

principles: Clear 3-tier hierarchy: page title > card title > body/table text
Numbers (stats, prices, counts) are visually heavier (bold) than their labels
No decorative fonts; readability and density prioritized

layout.gridStructure: 12-column responsive grid inside a fixed-sidebar shell

sections: primary nav group (Dashboard, Availability, Appointments, Requests, Records, Prescriptions, Patients)
secondary nav group under 'ACCOUNT' label (Profile, Settings, Logout)
user identity footer card (avatar, name, role, online status)
sidebar.activeStateStyle: solid accentBlue rounded rectangle behind item, white text, left content indent
sidebar.inactiveStateStyle: transparent bg, muted light-blue-gray text, icon+label horizontal

commonPageComposition: 1. Greeting/header hero banner (optional) — gradient or photo card with welcome text
2. Row of 4 KPI stat cards (icon, big number, label, link)
3. Two-column split: primary list/table card (wider) + secondary list card (narrower)
4. Secondary row: chart/graph card + summary/breakdown card (e.g. donut)
5. Full-width or grid of management cards (tables) for record-type pages
6. Detail/profile pages use a left-nav-tab + right-content two-pane layout inside the card

card.header: title (left) + optional action link/button (right), separated by bottom border or spacing before body

statCard.layout: icon chip (top-left, tinted colored square/circle) + label + large bold value + optional trailing chevron link
statCard.variants: one accent color per card (blue, green, purple/indigo, amber) used only for the icon chip

table.style: borderless rows separated by thin divider lines, no zebra striping
table.headerRow: muted gray uppercase-light text, no background fill
table.avatarColumn: small circular avatar + name stacked or inline with meta text below

badgePill.colorRule: tinted bg matching status semantic + matching darker text color, no border

quickActionButton.layout: icon (top or left) + label, in a light-bordered rounded rectangle, grid of 2-4 within a card
quickActionButton.hoverAffordance: subtle bg tint or border color change

calendar.layout: month grid, 7-column, header with month/year + prev/next chevrons

states.muted: adjacent-month days shown at reduced opacity

calendar.legend: row of colored dot + label chips beneath grid (e.g. Available/Booked/Expired/Blocked)

scheduleGrid.layout: day-of-week columns x time-slot rows, each cell a small rounded status chip (Available/Booked/Expired) color-coded
scheduleGrid.purpose: availability/slot visualization distinct from the month calendar

donutChart.style: multi-segment ring chart, thick stroke, rounded segment caps optional
donutChart.centerLabel: big total number + small caption stacked, centered inside ring
donutChart.legend: right-aligned or below, dot + label + value/percentage

lineAreaChart.style: smooth curved single-line chart with soft gradient fill beneath, light dot markers on hover/points, faint horizontal gridlines, axis labels in muted gray
lineAreaChart.controls: top-right dropdown/segmented control for date-range filter (e.g. 'Last 7 Days')

formInputs.select: same container style as text input with chevron icon right
formInputs.toggleTabs: segmented pill control for switching sub-sections (e.g. Personal Info / Professional Info / Documents)

profileHeaderBlock.layout: circular avatar (left) + name/ID/meta stacked (center) + key-value summary chips (right)

settingsPanel.layout: left vertical tab list (icon+label, active = tinted rounded rect) + right form panel with grouped fields and a primary Save button bottom-right

videoCallInterface.layout: large primary video tile filling most of the card, small self-view thumbnail inset (bottom or corner), side panel with participant/patient info card, bottom-centered floating control bar
videoCallInterface.controlBar: dark rounded pill/bar containing circular icon buttons (mute, video, share, chat, more) + a distinct red 'end call' pill button
videoCallInterface.statusIndicator: small colored dot + text top-left of video tile (e.g. connection quality)

notificationBell.style: icon button with small red count badge, top-right corner overlap

sidebarUserFooter.layout: avatar + name + role/title stacked, small colored online-status dot, sits pinned at sidebar bottom

iconography.usage: paired with nav labels, stat card chips, table actions, top feature badges (Secure/Comprehensive/Patient-Centered/Real-time/Professional)

elevationAndDepth.principle: Elevation communicated primarily through borders + very soft shadows, not heavy drop shadows
levels: level1-card: subtle 1-3px soft shadow + hairline border
level2-modal/dropdown/popover: slightly stronger shadow, same border style

responsiveNotes: Multi-card dashboard collapses from 4-column KPI row to 2-column then 1-column on smaller viewports
Sidebar collapses to icon-only or off-canvas with hamburger toggle on mobile/tablet
Tables convert to stacked card-per-row pattern on narrow screens
Two-pane detail views (nav tabs + content) stack vertically on mobile

brandingElements.logo: circular badge icon (medical/shield motif) + two-tone wordmark: bold navy primary word + teal secondary word beneath
brandingElements.topFeatureStrip: row of 4-5 minimal icon+label trust badges (e.g. Secure, Comprehensive, Patient-Centered, Real-time, Professional) used on hero/landing-style headers

instructions: When generating new screens, always start from the fixed sidebar + topbar shell defined in layout.shell before laying out page content.
Every distinct data grouping must be wrapped in the 'card' component pattern — never place raw tables or stats directly on the canvas background.
Use the color palette strictly by role: navy for chrome, blue for primary actions/active states, status colors only for semantic meaning (never decorative).
Default to rounded-corner, low-shadow, high-whitespace styling consistent with 'designStyle.visualPrinciples'.
Reuse componentPatterns as a library: prefer composing existing patterns (statCard, table, badgePill, quickActionButton, donutChart, lineAreaChart) over inventing new visual idioms.
Keep typography hierarchy consistent per typography.scale across all new pages for visual continuity.
This file intentionally omits example data (names, dates, numbers) — populate with the target application's real domain data at generation time.
